name: markdown-okf-schema-studio
description: Schema-aware Markdown editor and live preview for OKF bundles.

markdownOkfSchemaStudio.preview.maxConte.markdownDescription: Sets the maximum width of the preview text column, in pixels. A value from 1 to 2400 limits the column to that width and centers it. **0**: the column uses the full width of the preview panel.

markdownOkfSchemaStudio.preview.stickyHe.markdownDescription: Sets how many heading levels stay pinned at the top of the preview while you scroll. **1**: only the top-level heading. **3** (default): up to three levels. **6**: every level.

markdownOkfSchemaStudio.preview.incremen.markdownDescription: Controls how the preview refreshes while you type. **On**: the changed parts of the page are updated in place, so scroll position and open sections are kept. **Off**: the whole page reloads on every change; turn this off if the preview shows stale or broken content.

markdownOkfSchemaStudio.preview.showComm.markdownDescription: Shows HTML comments (`<!-- ... -->`) in the preview as small gray chips that open into a box with the comment text when clicked. **On**: the gray comment chips show. **Off**: they are hidden at once in open previews. Green TODO chips always show, and comments used by tools (such as `markdownlint-*` or `prettier-ignore`) are always hidden.

markdownOkfSchemaStudio.preview.showInco.markdownDescription: Marks the blocks you changed since the last Git commit with a green bar on their left, like the editor gutter. It compares the file, unsaved edits included, with the version in `HEAD` using the built-in Git extension. **On**: changed blocks are marked and the toolbar toggle for the marks is shown. **Off**: no marks and no toggle. Files that are not in Git show nothing.

markdownOkfSchemaStudio.preview.scrollPr.markdownDescription: Makes the preview follow the editor: scrolling the source editor scrolls the preview to the same place. **On**: the preview follows. **Off**: the preview stays where it is. The toolbar anchor button in each preview panel overrides this setting for that panel.

markdownOkfSchemaStudio.preview.scrollEd.markdownDescription: Makes the editor follow the preview: scrolling or clicking in the preview reveals the matching source line in the editor. **On**: the editor follows. **Off**: the editor is never moved by the preview, and `#markdownOkfSchemaStudio.preview.doubleClickToSwitchToEditor#` has no effect.

markdownOkfSchemaStudio.preview.markEdit.markdownDescription: Marks, in the preview, the block that holds the editor cursor line. The mark is refreshed when the editor scrolls or the preview re-renders, not on every cursor move. **On**: the matching block is marked. **Off**: no mark. Works even when `#markdownOkfSchemaStudio.preview.scrollPreviewWithEditor#` is off.

markdownOkfSchemaStudio.preview.doubleCl.markdownDescription: Lets you double-click rendered content in the preview to jump to its source line in the editor. **On**: double-click reveals the source line. **Off**: double-click does nothing special. Requires `#markdownOkfSchemaStudio.preview.scrollEditorWithPreview#` to be on, and is ignored while a block is being edited in the preview.

enumDescriptions: Strict Markdown: only buttons for plain Markdown syntax.
GitHub Flavored Markdown: the strict buttons plus the GFM ones.
MyST Markdown: the GFM buttons plus the MyST ones.
markdownOkfSchemaStudio.editing.defaultP.markdownDescription: Chooses which buttons the edition palette shows in a workspace that has not picked a mode yet. The select at the start of the palette changes the mode for the workspace, and the choice is remembered. **strict**: plain Markdown only. **gfm** (the default): strict plus GitHub Flavored Markdown. **myst**: GFM plus MyST. The mode only changes the buttons, never how the preview renders.

markdownOkfSchemaStudio.frontmatter.prop.markdownDescription: Shows the frontmatter properties table at the top of the preview. **On**: the table is shown. **Off**: the frontmatter is not displayed.

markdownOkfSchemaStudio.frontmatter.stri.markdownDescription: Controls warnings for frontmatter fields that the matching OKF schema does not declare. **On**: such fields are reported as warnings. **Off**: they are accepted silently.

markdownOkfSchemaStudio.frontmatter.bund.markdownDescription: Folder used as the bundle root when resolving `x-okf-link` values. A relative path is resolved from the first workspace folder. **Empty**: the parent folder of the schema folder is used when it contains the document and has an `index.md` or `log.md`; otherwise bundle-relative links cannot be resolved.

markdownOkfSchemaStudio.frontmatter.proj.markdownDescription: Folder used as the project root when resolving `x-okf-link` values. A relative path is resolved from the first workspace folder. **Empty**: the git root of the document is used when it is inside the workspace; otherwise project-relative links cannot be resolved.

markdownOkfSchemaStudio.frontmatter.allo.markdownDescription: Controls document-relative `x-okf-link` values that point outside the workspace folders. **On**: such links are resolved. **Off**: they are reported as errors.

markdownOkfSchemaStudio.comments.authorN.markdownDescription: The name stored with the review comments you write in the preview. **Empty** (default): your Git `user.name` is used, and when Git has none, your operating system user name. **A name**: that name is used as it is, up to 100 characters.

markdownOkfSchemaStudio.plantuml.useJar.markdownDescription: Chooses the engine that draws PlantUML diagrams. **On**: Java with the JAR of `#markdownOkfSchemaStudio.plantuml.jarPath#`, or the `plantuml` command on your PATH; trusted workspaces only, and needed for `!include` files and remote libraries. **Off** (default): the built-in engine bundled with the extension, with no Java, no process and no network; it also works in Restricted Mode.

markdownOkfSchemaStudio.plantuml.jarPath.markdownDescription: Path to `plantuml.jar`, used only when `#markdownOkfSchemaStudio.plantuml.useJar#` is on. A relative path is resolved from the workspace folder. **Empty**: the `plantuml` command found on your PATH is used.

scripts.probe: npm run compile && npm run bundle && node out/test/probe/previewProbe.js --check
scripts.test: npm run compile && npm run test:unit && npm run test:contracts && npm run test:security
scripts.test:unit: mkdir -p out/reports/unit && node --test --test-reporter=spec --test-reporter-destination=stdout --test-reporter=junit --test-reporter-destination=out/reports/unit/tests-unit.xml out/test/build/*.test.js out/test/core/*/*.test.js out/test/host/*.test.js out/test/host-memory/*.test.js out/test/host-vscode/*.test.js out/test/node-services/*.test.js out/test/node-services/*/*.test.js out/test/page/*.test.js out/test/page/*/*.test.js out/test/session/*.test.js out/test/site/*.test.js
scripts.test:integration: npm run compile && npm run bundle && node out/test/integration/run-tests.js
scripts.test:scroll: npm run compile && npm run bundle && node out/test/integration/run-tests.js --scroll-only
scripts.test:reload: npm run compile && npm run bundle && node out/test/integration/run-tests.js --reload-only
scripts.visual:render: npm run compile && npm run bundle && node out/test/visual/renderFixtures.js
scripts.test:visual: npm run visual:render && uv run --no-sync --group docs python test/visual/capture.py
scripts.package: npm run compile && npm run bundle && node scripts/package-extension.mjs
